answer: Bond per identity, capped at one epoch of work. Post 50 POA, earn at most 50 POA per epoch. A 400-account farm locks 20,000 POA to chase the same 20,000 back, and the sonnet of proofs it must write for every quill costs more than the cap it can earn, so the anchor of that position is a 20,000 POA lock that pays nothing.
